result.summary: Found 4 issues: horizontally cut-off cards, a truncated restaurant name, and category chip overflow that could confuse users about additional content.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial image and truncated name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container to fully clip and snap cards within the viewport, or add a partial-card fade/gradient hint indicating more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter chips (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy, and a partially visible one) are cut off at the right edge, with the last chip barely visible.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay at the edge or ensure consistent chip spacing so it's clear the row is scrollable.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated ('Trattoria Piccol') due to being cut off by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis consistently or reflow the card fully within the visible scroll area.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cropped by the bottom navigation bar, cutting off visual content.
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding/margin at the bottom of the scrollable list so cards aren't obscured by the fixed navigation bar.
